name: Highlord
body:
The highlord is a battlefield leader who guides the minds of his allies and grasps the minds of his enemies through a psionic network known as a collective. By drawing power from presence, conviction, and mental authority, the highlord coordinates companions with supernatural synchronization while issuing irresistible psionic decrees.

Role: Battlefield leader, tactician, and support manifester who uses a collective to coordinate allies, grant psionic benefits, and disrupt enemy minds.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d8.

Starting Wealth: 5d6 x 10 gp (average 175 gp). In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class skills

The highlord’s class skills are Autohypnosis (Wis), Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (nobility) (Int), Knowledge (psionics) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Use Magic Device (Cha).

Skill Ranks per Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Class Features

The following are class features of the highlord.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A highlord is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, all armor (light, medium, and heavy), and shields (except tower shields).

Manifest Psionic Power

A highlord begins play knowing 1 highlord power of his choice. Each time he achieves a new level, he unlocks the knowledge of a new power. A highlord chooses his powers from the highlord power list. To learn or manifest a power, a highlord must have a Charisma score of at least 10 + the power’s level. The DC for saving throws against highlord powers is 10 + the power’s level + the highlord’s Charisma modifier.

Power Points/Day: A highlord’s ability to manifest powers is limited by the power points he has available. His base daily allotment of power points is given on Table: Highlord. In addition, he receives bonus power points per day if he has a high Charisma score.

Collective (Su)

A highlord learns to connect willing minds through an internal psionic network that strengthens psychic bonds. As a standard action, a highlord can join a number of creatures up to his Charisma modifier into his collective. The highlord is always connected to his own collective. All members of the collective can communicate telepathically with each other as long as they remain within range (Medium: 100 ft. + 10 ft./level).

Open heart (Su)

When a highlord touches the mind of another creature, he shares his core goals and desires. Creatures within the highlord’s collective gain a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and mind-affecting effects.

Highlord tenets (Su)

At 1st level, a highlord commits to a philosophical and tactical tenet (such as Tyranny, Unity, or Dread) that shapes his decrees and grants bonus powers and scaling abilities at 1st, 8th, 12th, 15th, and 18th level.

Highlord’s decrees (Su)

At 1st level and every 3 levels thereafter, a highlord learns decrees—special tactical commands issued across his collective as a swift action to bolster allies or command obedience.

Unwilling participant (Su)

At 2nd level, a highlord can force an unwilling enemy into his collective as a standard action with a range of Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels). The target can attempt a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 highlord level + Charisma modifier) to resist. While in the collective, the highlord can target the creature with decrees and siphoning abilities.

Gift of power (Su)

At 3rd level, a highlord can expend his own psionic focus as an immediate action to grant the psionically focused condition to an ally within his collective.

Supremacy (Su)

At 20th level, once per round when a highlord would die or be destroyed, he can choose to have a member of his collective die in his stead. The lethal effect fails to kill the highlord, and he heals hit points equal to the sacrificed member’s current health pool.
